name: agy-discord-channel
description: Claude-Code-style session-bound Discord bot channel plugin for Google Antigravity CLI (agy).

scripts.syntax: sh -n plugins/agy-discord-channel/bin/agy-discord && sh -n plugins/agy-discord-channel/bin/agy-discord-mcp && bash -n plugins/agy-discord-channel/bin/agy-discord-instance && sh -n plugins/agy-discord-channel/hooks/session-bind.sh && node --check scripts/build-runtime.js && node --check scripts/smoke.js && node --check plugins/agy-discord-channel/src/*.js && node --check tests/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run syntax && npm test && npm run build:check && npm run smoke
